newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-MAJOLI WINS THROUGH TO HANOVER FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MAJOLI WINS THROUGH TO HANOVER FINAL.

text.p: Defending champion Iva Majoli of Croatia won though to the final of the Hanover Grand Prix tournament on Saturday with a straight sets victory over Austria's Barbara Paulus.
Paulus, seeded sixth, pushed Majoli hard in the first set of their semifinal before the third seed triumphed 7-4 in the tie-break.
Majoli looked much more comfortable in the second set and took the match 7-6 6-4.
The Croatian will face top seed Jana Novotna of the Czech Republic in the Hanover final for the third year in succession.
Novotna had little trouble overcoming Magdalena Maleeva of Bulgaria 6-0 7-5 in the other semifinal.
